from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyNonCurrentAssets(BaseModel):
    """One company's non-current assets total from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name as named in the report")
    non_current_assets_total: float | None = Field(description="Total non-current assets amount")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of financial statement, e.g., '合并资产负债表'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_non_current_assets: list[CompanyNonCurrentAssets]
